**Drag a file, tap a key, pick a format.** PomeloO converts and edits files on your own PC: nothing is uploaded.

## New in 1.1.8
- **QR codes on posters**: Win+Ctrl+T now reads a QR code printed straight onto a colored background with no white
  margin around it (it used to say "No text found").

## New in 1.1.7
- **Copy a QR link from the screen**: press **Win+Ctrl+T** and drag over a QR code; only its contents (the link)
  are copied, not the text around it. Even small QR codes on screen are read.

## New in 1.1.6
- **PomeloO updates itself.** Once a day it checks GitHub for a new version, downloads it, checks its SHA-256 and
  installs it while you're not using the PC (nothing running, no window open), then starts again. Tray →
  **Check for updates…** does it right away; Settings → **Update automatically** turns it off. The portable zip only
  tells you when a new version is out. *Coming from 1.1.5 or older? Install this one by hand once; after that it's
  automatic.*

## New in 1.1.5
- **Smaller notch**: Settings → Notch → **Size → Small** makes the pill, the notices and the ideas strip smaller.
  The panel and the drop zones keep their room.

## New in 1.1.4
- **Notch on battery saver**: hovering the notch and moving away no longer leaves a blank black box on screen.

## New in 1.1.3
- **Settings fits small screens**: it opens no taller than the screen, scrolls, and can be resized from the
  bottom-right corner, so **Save** is always in reach.
- **Phone in the notch**: **Stop** now ends sharing *and* closes the notch. Sharing also ends by itself when the
  QR code leaves the screen (another tab, the notch closes) or after 10 minutes without a file from the phone.

## Install
1. Download **PomeloO-Setup-x.y.z.exe** below and run it. No admin rights are needed; it installs for your user only.
2. Windows may show *"Windows protected your PC"* because the installer isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. PomeloO starts in the tray (orange icon) and from then on with Windows.

Prefer no installer? Unzip **PomeloO-x.y.z-portable.zip** anywhere and run `PomeloO.exe`.

Requires Windows 10 (1809+) or Windows 11, 64-bit.

## Use
| Do this | To |
|---|---|
| Drag a file in Explorer, tap **Shift** / **Ctrl** / **Alt** | Convert / Tools / Actions wheel |
| Right-click a file → Show more options → **PomeloO** | the same as a menu |
| Select files, press **Ctrl+Shift+Space** | wheel with the keyboard (no selection: what you copied) |
| **Win+Ctrl+T**, drag over the screen | copy any text (or QR code) you can see |
| Copy an image, **Ctrl+V** in a folder | save it there as a PNG |
| Drag a file to the **top of the screen** | the notch's drop zones: convert, shelf, phone, fit for WhatsApp / email / web |
| Hover the **notch** (top centre) | shelf, jobs, clipboard, recent results, phone |
| Tray icon | Receive from phone, Recipes, History, Settings |

## New in 1.1: the notch
A black pill at the top of the screen. Hover it for your **shelf** (files kept handy; Shift+drag drops
them converted), **jobs** (progress, cancel, size saved), **clipboard** history, **recent** results with
undo and the **phone** QR code. Drag a file to the top and it becomes **drop zones**: convert, shelf,
phone, *Fit WhatsApp / Email / Web* and your recipes. New downloads and copied screenshots get one-click
ideas. It hides for full-screen apps and never shows in screen sharing. Settings → Notch to adjust.

## What's inside
- 275+ conversions: images (incl. HEIC, AVIF, SVG), audio, video, GIF, PDF, Word, Markdown, EPUB, slides, spreadsheets, subtitles, archives (incl. RAR).
- 34 tools: compress to a size, photo editor, annotate, background, crop, redact with face/text detection, collage, trim/split/join/speed, snapshots, loudness, bleep, visualizer, burn-in subtitles, PDF merge/split/organize/password/watermark/page numbers, copy text (OCR), searchable PDF, metadata, QR, extract.
- 8 actions: Share, Float, Copy, Move, Copy Path, Terminal, Rename (patterns, date taken), **Send to Phone** (QR code over Wi-Fi, both directions).
- Recipes (several steps as one ★ item, optional watch folder) and History with undo.

## Uninstall
Settings → Apps → PomeloO → Uninstall. It removes the app, the right-click menu and the start-with-Windows entry.

Setelah terpasang, PomeloO ada di tray dan ikut jalan saat Windows menyala. Semua proses terjadi di laptopmu sendiri, tidak ada file yang diunggah.
